result.question: What was Tesla's gross profit in fiscal year 2024?
result.answer: Tesla's gross profit in fiscal year 2024 was $17,450 million (approximately $17.45 billion), as reported in its Consolidated Statements of Operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 [0001628280-25-003063:item-8-p005]. This figure is also confirmed by the XBRL-tagged gross profit fact of $17,450,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2024 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:GrossProfit:2024-12-31]. For context, this represented a slight decline from the prior year's gross profit of $17,660 million in fiscal year 2023 [0001628280-25-003063:item-8-p005].
